dress.skirt_maximum_puff_gathered.description: MAXIMUM puff - extreme gathered fullness, very short
dress.skirt_maximum_puff_gathered.contents: CRITICAL: Skirt EXTREMELY SHORT - iliac crest or above - at fingertip level. Hem well above knee. Skirt puffs out EXTREMELY WIDE - extends 20-30cm horizontally from body.

dress.skirt_eight_tier_super_ruffle.description: EIGHT tier ruffle - maximum horizontal volume, very short
dress.skirt_eight_tier_super_ruffle.contents: CRITICAL: Skirt EXTREMELY SHORT - iliac crest or above - at fingertip level. Eight horizontal ruffle tiers stacked high to low. Each tier 8-10cm wide dramatic ruffle. Skirt extends 20-30cm wide horizontally from body at widest point. Tiers create continuous stacked puff.

dress.skirt_double_circle_ultra_gathered.description: Double circle skirt - extreme fullness, very short length
dress.skirt_double_circle_ultra_gathered.contents: CRITICAL: Skirt EXTREMELY SHORT - iliac crest or above - at fingertip level. Skirt from TWO full circle patterns (double circle). Massive puff when gathered. Extends 20-30cm horizontally wide. Gathered at high waist.

dress.skirt_cloud_tulle_explosion.description: MAXIMUM tulle cloud - architectural volume, very short
dress.skirt_cloud_tulle_explosion.contents: CRITICAL: Skirt EXTREMELY SHORT - iliac crest or above - at fingertip level. Skirt from 12-16 layers gathered tulle creating ENORMOUS architectural cloud. Extends 20-30cm wide horizontally. Gathered high at waist.

dress.skirt_triple_layer_mega_puff.description: THREE skirt layers - maximum compound volume, very short
dress.skirt_triple_layer_mega_puff.contents: CRITICAL: Skirt EXTREMELY SHORT - iliac crest or above - at fingertip level. THREE separate skirt layers creating compound mega puff. Extends 20-30cm wide horizontally from body.

dress.skirt_wide_tier_maximum.description: Six EXTRA-WIDE ruffle tiers - extreme width, very short
dress.skirt_wide_tier_maximum.contents: CRITICAL: Skirt EXTREMELY SHORT - iliac crest or above - at fingertip level. Six extra-wide ruffle tiers. Each tier 10-12cm wide. Skirt extends 20-30cm wide horizontally from body. Tiers create stacked extremely wide puff silhouette.
